theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (G : Set (Euclid P)) (k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → 1 ≤ k → (∀ y ∈ G, y ∈ Q ∧ HasMassDensity C y k ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball y r ⊆ G ∧ C.support ∩ ball y r ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) → R.Represents C → ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), y ∈ G → y ∈ R.carrier ∧ R.mult y = k ∧ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier y = Q
